titleText: JTF News: The Guardian, CBC News
mainText: At least 70 people killed and 30 injured in a gang attack in Haiti.
Three individuals were arrested in Paris following a reported attempted bomb attack outside a Bank of America location.
Three UN peacekeepers were killed in south Lebanon within 24 hours during Israel-Hezbollah conflict.
The United Nations reports two peacekeepers killed in an explosion in south Lebanon.
President Trump stated he could seize Iran's Kharg Island as the United States increases troop presence in the Middle East.
